about: The Agimus tibi gratias is a short thanksgiving traditionally said after a meal. Those gathered thank almighty God for all His benefits and confess that He lives and reigns forever.

seg.tr: We give You thanks, almighty God,

ex.w001: With “grátias”, it forms the fixed expression “grátias ágere” — to give thanks.

seg.tr: who live and reign forever and ever. Amen.
